# 00.house

> 00.house is a rental property listings and open-house scheduling portal for the United Kingdom, connecting tenants with agents and landlords in England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland.

00.house lets tenants search for rental homes by city or postcode, browse property categories (independent villas, townhouses, homes with a garden or terrace, new-build homes), and complete a one-minute "Tenant Pass" to be matched with agents and landlords who have a relevant open house. There is no commission charged to tenants on enquiries. Agents and landlords can list open houses once and reach ready-to-view tenants across their area.

## Key facts

- Coverage: England, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland (rental listings only — not for sale).
- Average monthly private rent shown on the site (source: ONS Price Index of Private Rents; England, Wales, Scotland: August 2026; Northern Ireland: June 2026):
  - England: £1,459 pcm
  - Wales: £846 pcm
  - Scotland: £1,013 pcm
  - Northern Ireland: £874 pcm
- Rent cap on the platform: up to £8,600 per month (approx. €10,000).
- No commission charged to tenants on enquiries.
- Tenant Pass: a short verification/preference profile that takes about one minute to complete.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://00.house/): search by city/postcode, browse property categories, UK rent-by-nation overview, local area map, tenant and agent sign-up.
- [Tenants](https://00.house/tenants.html): information and sign-up for tenants using 00.house.

## Contact

- Agent/landlord partner enquiries and tenant enquiries are handled through the sign-up forms on the homepage.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Rent figures above are averages from the Office for National Statistics, displayed for context; they are not 00.house's own listing prices and change over time — always mention the source (ONS) and approximate date if citing these figures.
- 00.house is a rental platform only; it does not handle home sales.
